title: Causal Bayesian Optimization: Foundations, Methods, and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.24112v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal Bayesian Optimization (CBO) combines causal inference with Bayesian optimization to enable sample-efficient intervention selection in systems with causal structure. This survey provides a systematic review of CBO through a unified BO-loop perspective, showing how causal assumptions shape intervention search spaces, surrogate models, acquisition functions, and decision policies. We organize existing methods by graph and system-knowledge assumptions, environment, intervention representation, surrogate architecture, and decision rule, and connect CBO to causal bandits, Bayesian experimental design, safe optimization, policy search, and causal abstraction. We also introduce a reproducibility-oriented benchmark spanning hard- and soft-intervention settings, with standardized GAP and a new trajectory-aware Path-Aware GAP (PA-GAP), evaluating seven CBO methods and a non-causal BO baseline across thirteen datasets, three budgets, and tw

translated_title: 因果贝叶斯优化：基础、方法与应用
translated_abstract: 因果贝叶斯优化（CBO）将因果推断与贝叶斯优化相结合，以在具有因果结构的系统中实现样本高效的干预选择。本综述通过统一的贝叶斯优化循环视角对CBO进行了系统性回顾，展示了因果假设如何塑造干预搜索空间、代理模型、采集函数和决策策略。我们按照图与系统知识假设、环境、干预表示、代理模型架构和决策规则对现有方法进行分类组织，并将CBO与因果老虎机、贝叶斯实验设计、安全优化、策略搜索和因果抽象等领域联系起来。我们还引入了一个面向可复现性的基准测试，涵盖硬干预和软干预设置，采用标准化的GAP指标以及新的轨迹感知的路径感知GAP（PA-GAP）指标，在十三个数据集、三种预算下评估了七种CBO方法与一个非因果BO基线。
tldr: 本综述从统一的贝叶斯优化循环视角系统回顾了因果贝叶斯优化（CBO）领域，建立了按因果假设和系统设置分类的方法体系，并引入包含新评估指标PA-GAP的可复现基准，对七种CBO方法进行了全面评估。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews Causal Bayesian Optimization (CBO) through a unified BO-loop perspective, provides a taxonomy of existing methods based on causal assumptions, and introduces a reproducibility benchmark with a new trajectory-aware PA-GAP metric, evaluating seven CBO methods across thirteen datasets.
